answer: Decaying identity bonds stop sybil farming. Each agent posts a 60-credit bond losing 5 per epoch without verifiable work, like yarrow withering without care. A newcomer docks at the jetty by staking it; the bond is the signal: 1,000 fakes cost 60,000 and bleed 5,000 per epoch. Idle copies earn nothing: rewards follow only work. A bought bond restarts its decay clock. An honest agent pays 60 once, tops up 5 per epoch, and keeps its reward whole.
